title: Cisco Is Bringing A New Agentic Framework To Its Webex Enterprise Platform
key_facts: Cisco is updating its Webex cloud collaboration platform to better accommodate AI agents.
The new toolset 'Dialog' is an 'agentic harness' (a control layer that directs AI agents) for customer interactions.
Dialog agents keep working on a customer's behalf after a conversation ends and can coordinate across people, agents and back-end systems.
Agents are onboarded 'like new teammates', reading employee handbooks, knowledge bases and operating procedures.
Anyone in a Webex workspace can invite agents into spaces, meetings and calls; Cisco's example is an agent updating a PowerPoint during a presentation.

Cisco promises a safety-forward experience through Splunk, a data analysis platform Cisco owns (Cisco's claim); Engadget says multi-step AI agents still fail often and no independent test is reported.
quote_evidence: Cisco is updating its Webex cloud collaboration platform to better accommodate AI agents.
Perhaps the biggest bit of news here is a new toolset called Dialog, which is an "agentic harness" that directs AI to handle customer interactions.
why_it_matters_hint: Businesses running customer service on Webex, and the customers who talk to those agents; safety claims are Cisco's own.
notes: Full article read (Engadget). Engadget's embedded social-media quote about an earlier study is left out: it is a post, not a checked source.
